description: The file defines the IPCMessage class used for encoding and decoding inter-process communication messages, including request and reply handling with payloads in JSON format.

classes.name: IPCMessage
classes.description: A container class for encoding and decoding IPC request and reply messages with payloads, message codes, and return codes.

methods.name: decodeRequest
methods.description: Decodes an IPC request message from an input stream, extracting message code and payload.

methods.name: decodeReply
methods.description: Decodes an IPC reply message from an input stream, extracting return code and payload.

methods.name: encodeRequest
methods.description: Encodes the message as a request to an output stream, using message code and payload.

methods.name: encodeReply
methods.description: Encodes the message as a reply to an output stream, using return code and payload.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: A static helper method that decodes message data from an input stream, extracting code and payload.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: A static helper method that encodes a message code and payload into an output stream.

methods.name: getMessageCode
methods.description: Returns the message code (used in requests).

methods.name: getReturnCode
methods.description: Returns the return code (used in replies).
